## 📋 Global Security Schemes

**Add to all three OpenAPI specs** (`components.securitySchemes`):

```yaml
components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
      description: |
        JWT access token issued by Auth Service. Contains user ID, role, and session metadata.
        **Expiry**: 15 minutes (configurable)
        **Refresh**: Use `/api/v1/auth/refresh` with refresh token
        **HIPAA Compliance**: Tokens are logged in audit trails with timestamp and action context.
      
    sessionCookie:
      type: apiKey
      in: cookie
      name: jibonflow_session
      description: |
        Session cookie for web applications. Httponly, Secure, SameSite=Strict.
        **Expiry**: 8 hours absolute, 15 minutes idle timeout
        **HIPAA Compliance**: Session IDs are cryptographically random (128-bit entropy) and rotated after privilege escalation.
      
    mfaToken:
      type: apiKey
      in: header
      name: X-MFA-Token
      description: |
        Temporary MFA verification token issued during login. Required for provider/admin accounts.
        **Expiry**: 5 minutes
        **Usage**: One-time use only (invalidated after successful MFA verification)
      
    apiKey:
      type: apiKey
      in: header
      name: X-API-Key
      description: |
        API key for B2B integrations (pharmacy/pharma portals). Scoped to specific resources.
        **Rotation**: Every 90 days (automated reminder sent at 80 days)
        **HIPAA Compliance**: API key usage is logged with IP address and endpoint accessed.

  # Global Security Extensions
  x-security-requirements:
    hipaa:
      encryption:
        atRest: AES-256-GCM
        inTransit: TLS 1.3 minimum
        e2ee: Required for telemedicine video/audio (AES-128-GCM)
      auditLogging:
        enabled: true
        retention: 6 years minimum (HIPAA requirement)
        fields: [userId, action, resource, timestamp, ipAddress, userAgent]
        tamperProof: Cryptographically signed logs (HMAC-SHA256)
      accessControl:
        rbac: [patient, chw, provider, pharmacy, pharma, admin]
        sessionTimeout: 
          idle: 15 minutes
          absolute: 8 hours
        mfaRequired: [provider, admin]
    
    gdpr:
      dataSubjectRights:
        access: /api/v1/data-export
        erasure: /api/v1/data-deletion
        portability: /api/v1/fhir-export
        rectification: /api/v1/patients/{patientId} (PUT)
      consentManagement:
        endpoint: /api/v1/consents
        granularity: Purpose-specific (marketing, analytics, sharing)
        withdrawal: Immediate effect (soft-delete with audit trail)
      legalBasis:
        - Consent (patient data processing)
        - Legitimate Interest (fraud prevention)
        - Legal Obligation (HIPAA audit requirements)

  # Common Headers
  parameters:
    AcceptLanguageHeader:
      name: Accept-Language
      in: header
      required: false
      schema:
        type: string
        enum: [en-US, bn-BD, en-GB]
        default: en-US
      description: |
        Preferred language for response messages and error text.
        **Supported Languages**:
        - `en-US`: English (United States)
        - `bn-BD`: Bangla (Bangladesh)
        - `en-GB`: English (British)
        
        **Low-Literacy Support**: When `bn-BD` is specified, error messages use simplified vocabulary (6th grade reading level).
    
    RequestPriorityHeader:
      name: X-Request-Priority
      in: header
      required: false
      schema:
        type: string
        enum: [high, normal, low]
        default: normal
      description: |
        Hint for 3G bandwidth optimization. High-priority requests are processed first and may receive compressed responses.
        **Use Cases**:
        - `high`: Critical health data (symptoms, prescriptions, telemedicine)
        - `normal`: Profile updates, appointment scheduling
        - `low`: Marketing content, analytics beacons
    
    CorrelationIdHeader:
      name: X-Correlation-Id
      in: header
      required: false
      schema:
        type: string
        format: uuid
      description: |
        Unique identifier for request tracing across microservices.
        **HIPAA Audit Trail**: Correlation IDs are logged with every PHI access for incident response.
    
    UserAgentHeader:
      name: User-Agent
      in: header
      required: false
      schema:
        type: string
      description: |
        Client application identifier (e.g., "JibonFlow-Patient-Mobile/1.2.0 iOS/17.0").
        **Analytics**: Used to track platform distribution and version adoption rates.

  # Common Response Schemas
  schemas:
    HIPAAMetadata:
      type: object
      description: Metadata attached to PHI responses for compliance tracking
      required: [accessTimestamp, userId, action, correlationId]
      properties:
        accessTimestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: ISO 8601 timestamp of PHI access (UTC)
          example: "2025-10-11T14:23:45.123Z"
        userId:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          description: UUID of authenticated user accessing PHI
        action:
          type: string
          enum: [read, create, update, delete, export]
          description: CRUD operation performed on PHI
        resource:
          type: string
          description: Resource type accessed (e.g., "Patient", "MedicalHistory")
          example: "Patient"
        correlationId:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          description: Request correlation ID for end-to-end tracing
        ipAddress:
          type: string
          format: ipv4
          description: Client IP address (hashed for long-term storage)
          example: "192.168.1.1"
    
    GDPRConsentRecord:
      type: object
      description: GDPR consent tracking for patient data processing
      required: [consentId, purpose, granted, timestamp]
      properties:
        consentId:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          description: Unique consent record identifier
        purpose:
          type: string
          enum: [essential, marketing, analytics, dataSharingResearch]
          description: |
            Purpose categories aligned with GDPR Article 6:
            - `essential`: Service delivery (legal basis: contract)
            - `marketing`: Promotional communications (legal basis: consent)
            - `analytics`: Usage analytics (legal basis: legitimate interest)
            - `dataSharingResearch`: Anonymized research sharing (legal basis: consent)
        granted:
          type: boolean
          description: Whether consent was granted (true) or withdrawn (false)
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: When consent was granted/withdrawn (UTC)
        expiryDate:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: When consent expires (null for perpetual consent)
          nullable: true
        method:
          type: string
          enum: [explicit, implicit, chw-assisted]
          description: How consent was obtained
    
    PaginationMetadata:
      type: object
      description: Pagination metadata for mobile-first optimization
      required: [page, pageSize, totalItems, totalPages]
      properties:
        page:
          type: integer
          minimum: 1
          description: Current page number (1-indexed)
          example: 1
        pageSize:
          type: integer
          minimum: 10
          maximum: 100
          description: Items per page (limited to 100 for 3G bandwidth)
          example: 20
        totalItems:
          type: integer
          description: Total number of items across all pages
          example: 450
        totalPages:
          type: integer
          description: Total number of pages
          example: 23
        hasNextPage:
          type: boolean
          description: Whether more pages are available
        hasPreviousPage:
          type: boolean
          description: Whether previous pages exist
        nextCursor:
          type: string
          description: Cursor for next page (for cursor-based pagination)
          nullable: true
        estimatedDataSize:
          type: string
          description: Estimated response size (e.g., "125 KB") for bandwidth awareness
          example: "125 KB"
    
    LocalizedErrorMessage:
      type: object
      description: Error message with multi-language support
      required: [code, message, locale]
      properties:
        code:
          type: string
          description: Machine-readable error code (e.g., "AUTH_001")
          example: "AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS"
        message:
          type: string
          description: Human-readable error message in requested locale
          example: "Invalid phone number or password. Please try again."
        messageBn:
          type: string
          description: Bangla translation of error message (optional)
          example: "ভুল ফোন নম্বর বা পাসওয়ার্ড। আবার চেষ্টা করুন।"
        locale:
          type: string
          enum: [en-US, bn-BD]
          description: Locale of the message field
        voiceAssistHint:
          type: string
          description: Simplified message for text-to-speech engines (6th grade reading level)
          example: "Wrong phone number or password. Try again."
        suggestedAction:
          type: string
          description: Guidance on how to resolve the error
          example: "Check your phone number and password, then try again."
        helpLink:
          type: string
          format: uri
          description: Link to help documentation or support
          example: "https://jibonflow.com/help/login-issues"
```

## 🔐 Auth Service Enhancements

### New Endpoints to Add

#### 1. **GDPR Data Export** (Right to Access)

```yaml
  /api/v1/auth/data-export:
    post:
      summary: Request user data export (GDPR Article 15)
      description: |
        Initiates an asynchronous export of all user data in FHIR R4 format.
        Includes authentication history, session logs, and consent records.
        **GDPR Compliance**: Must complete within 30 days of request.
      tags: [GDPR]
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/AcceptLanguageHeader'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/CorrelationIdHeader'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [format]
              properties:
                format:
                  type: string
                  enum: [json, fhir-r4-bundle, csv]
                  description: Export format preference
                  default: fhir-r4-bundle
                includeAuditLogs:
                  type: boolean
                  description: Whether to include HIPAA audit logs (admin only)
                  default: false
                deliveryMethod:
                  type: string
                  enum: [download, email]
                  default: download
      responses:
        '202':
          description: Export request accepted (async processing)
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [exportId, status, estimatedCompletionTime]
                properties:
                  exportId:
                    type: string
                    format: uuid
                  status:
                    type: string
                    enum: [pending, processing, completed, failed]
                  estimatedCompletionTime:
                    type: string
                    format: date-time
                    description: Estimated completion time (usually 24 hours)
                  downloadUrl:
                    type: string
                    format: uri
                    description: URL to download export (available when status=completed)
                    nullable: true
                  expiresAt:
                    type: string
                    format: date-time
                    description: When download URL expires (7 days after completion)
        '429':
          description: Rate limit exceeded (max 1 export per 24 hours)
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/LocalizedErrorMessage'
      x-hipaa-protected: false
      x-gdpr-data-subject-right: access
```

#### 2. **GDPR Data Deletion** (Right to Erasure)

```yaml
  /api/v1/auth/data-deletion:
    delete:
      summary: Request account and data deletion (GDPR Article 17)
      description: |
        Initiates account deactivation and data deletion workflow.
        **Retention Override**: Medical records are retained for 6 years per HIPAA.
        **Anonymization**: PHI is anonymized after verification instead of hard deletion.
      tags: [GDPR]
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/AcceptLanguageHeader'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/CorrelationIdHeader'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [confirmationCode, reason]
              properties:
                confirmationCode:
                  type: string
                  description: SMS confirmation code sent to registered phone
                  pattern: '^\d{6}$'
                reason:
                  type: string
                  enum: [noLongerNeed, privacyConcerns, switchingProvider, other]
                  description: Reason for deletion (anonymous analytics)
                detailedReason:
                  type: string
                  maxLength: 500
                  description: Optional detailed explanation
      responses:
        '202':
          description: Deletion request accepted (async processing)
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [deletionId, status, gracePeriodEnds]
                properties:
                  deletionId:
                    type: string
                    format: uuid
                  status:
                    type: string
                    enum: [pending, processing, completed]
                  gracePeriodEnds:
                    type: string
                    format: date-time
                    description: 30-day grace period before permanent deletion
                  retainedDataTypes:
                    type: array
                    description: Data types retained for legal compliance (HIPAA)
                    items:
                      type: string
                      enum: [medicalRecords, prescriptions, billingHistory]
        '400':
          description: Invalid confirmation code
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/LocalizedErrorMessage'
      x-hipaa-protected: true
      x-gdpr-data-subject-right: erasure
```

#### 3. **MFA Setup** (Provider/Admin Accounts)

```yaml
  /api/v1/auth/mfa/setup:
    post:
      summary: Enable multi-factor authentication
      description: |
        Generates TOTP secret and QR code for MFA enrollment.
        **Required for**: Provider and admin accounts (HIPAA security requirement).
      tags: [MFA]
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/CorrelationIdHeader'
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [method]
              properties:
                method:
                  type: string
                  enum: [totp, sms]
                  description: MFA method preference
                phoneNumber:
                  type: string
                  pattern: '^\+880\d{10}$'
                  description: Phone number for SMS MFA (required if method=sms)
      responses:
        '200':
          description: MFA setup initiated
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [secret, qrCodeUrl, backupCodes]
                properties:
                  secret:
                    type: string
                    description: TOTP secret (base32 encoded)
                    example: "JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP"
                  qrCodeUrl:
                    type: string
                    format: uri
                    description: QR code data URL for authenticator app
                  backupCodes:
                    type: array
                    description: One-time backup codes (8 codes)
                    minItems: 8
                    maxItems: 8
                    items:
                      type: string
                      pattern: '^\d{8}$'
                  nextStep:
                    type: string
                    description: Instructions for completing MFA setup
                    example: "Scan QR code with Google Authenticator, then verify with /api/v1/auth/mfa/verify"
        '400':
          description: MFA already enabled or invalid phone number
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/LocalizedErrorMessage'
      x-hipaa-protected: false
      x-rbac-required: [provider, admin]
```

## 🏥 Patient Management Service Enhancements

### New FHIR R4 Export Endpoint

```yaml
  /api/v1/fhir/export:
    get:
      summary: Bulk FHIR R4 data export (GDPR portability)
      description: |
        Exports patient data as FHIR R4 Bundle conforming to US Core profiles.
        **GDPR Compliance**: Right to data portability (Article 20).
        **HIPAA Compliance**: Encrypted export with audit logging.
      tags: [FHIR]
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/AcceptLanguageHeader'
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/CorrelationIdHeader'
        - name: _type
          in: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [Patient, Condition, MedicationRequest, Encounter, Observation]
          description: Resource types to include (comma-separated)
        - name: _since
          in: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            format: date-time
          description: Only include resources modified after this timestamp
      responses:
        '200':
          description: FHIR R4 Bundle
          content:
            application/fhir+json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [resourceType, type, entry]
                properties:
                  resourceType:
                    type: string
                    enum: [Bundle]
                  type:
                    type: string
                    enum: [collection]
                  timestamp:
                    type: string
                    format: date-time
                  entry:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: object
                      required: [resource]
                      properties:
                        fullUrl:
                          type: string
                          format: uri
                        resource:
                          type: object
                          description: FHIR R4 resource (Patient, Condition, etc.)
                  x-hipaa-metadata:
                    $ref: '#/components/schemas/HIPAAMetadata'
        '403':
          description: Patient can only export their own data
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/LocalizedErrorMessage'
      x-hipaa-protected: true
      x-gdpr-data-subject-right: portability
```

## 🎥 Telemedicine Service Enhancements

### New Endpoints for Video Session Security

```yaml
  /api/v1/telemedicine/sessions/{sessionId}/encryption-key:
    post:
      summary: Generate E2EE session key for video call
      description: |
        Returns an ephemeral AES-128-GCM key for end-to-end encrypted video/audio.
        **HIPAA Compliance**: Keys are rotated every 15 minutes during active sessions.
        **Agora Integration**: Pass this key to Agora SDK's `setEncryptionSecret()`.
      tags: [Sessions]
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: sessionId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
        - $ref: '#/components/parameters/CorrelationIdHeader'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Encryption key generated
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [key, expiresAt, algorithm]
                properties:
                  key:
                    type: string
                    description: Base64-encoded AES-128-GCM key
                    example: "dGVzdGtleXRlc3RrZXl0ZXN0a2V5dGVzdA=="
                  expiresAt:
                    type: string
                    format: date-time
                    description: When key expires (15 minutes from now)
                  algorithm:
                    type: string
                    enum: [aes-128-gcm2]
                    description: Encryption algorithm (Agora-compatible)
                  rotationSchedule:
                    type: string
                    description: When next key rotation will occur
                    example: "Every 15 minutes during active session"
        '404':
          description: Session not found or expired
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/LocalizedErrorMessage'
      x-hipaa-protected: true
      x-encryption-required: e2ee
```
